Unlike the *_baseline.json ratchets this tracks current truth in both directions -- a definition change is an event, not a defect.

metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.meaning: How available/reachable a compute node currently is.
How much spare operating capacity a capability has right now. Derived as 1 - pressure unless an edge writes it directly; absent when pressure is unmeasured (never a fabricated 1.0).
Per-step verbosity of the FCC motor's tool output for one turn.
Athena cabinet ambient microphone activity (CMTECK USB RMS band deviation). Levels-only -- not speech content. Distinct from fan_pressure and thermal_pressure.
Whether Athena's ambient microphone snapshot is too stale to trust. When elevated, cabinet_ambient_audio_activity is withheld upstream -- this channel carries the liveness signal instead.
Athena cabinet climate sensor activity (BME680 temperature/humidity/pressure band deviation). Distinct from node thermal_pressure -- measures the enclosure ambient, not CPU/GPU die heat.
Athena cabinet electromagnetic activity (AD8313 RF power band deviation).
Athena cabinet particulate/air-quality sensor activity (PMS5003 band deviation).
Athena cabinet proximity/presence sensor activity (VL53L0X band deviation).
Whether Athena's cabinet Arduino sensor bundle is too stale to trust. When elevated, cabinet activity channels are withheld upstream -- this channel carries the liveness signal instead.
Athena cabinet UV sensor activity (GUVA-S12SD band deviation).
Athena cabinet vibration activity (MPU6050 accel deviation from 1g rest).

Share of bus channels seen live that are missing from the declared catalog (orion/bus/channels.yaml): the bus observer's census, undeclared_active_count / catalog_size, on node:athena (falls back to the observer's own configured-stream check when the census did not run). capability:transport carries 0.85 x the node:athena reading (it was named contract_pressure until 2026-10-07). Not a payload/schema check: OrionBusAsync.publish() validates every payload before sending.

Did the FCC motor actually produce a compliant, delivered turn -- HarnessRunV1.compliance_verdict rank (completed/partial/failed/refused), distinct from failure_pressure since a turn can resolve partial with zero individual tool-step failures.

How confident the system is that a given capability is currently reliable/available. Derived as 1 - 0.5 * pressure unless an edge writes it directly; absent when pressure is unmeasured (never a fabricated 1.0).

What fraction of one FCC-motor turn's classified tool calls were read-only research/context tools (Read, Grep, WebSearch, mcp__gitnexus__*, mcp__firecrawl__*, ...) vs action/mutation tools (Bash, Edit, Write, other MCP tools) -- composition, not volume (harness_step_load already covers volume). A fixed, deterministic tool-name allowlist, not a taxonomy: an unmatched tool name increments neither bucket, so 0.0 can mean either all-execution or zero-classified-calls.
How much active conversational load (turn volume/complexity) is occurring.

Renamed from execution_load 2026-07-24 for scope honesty (the sibling of harness_step_load, cortex-exec-scoped instead of harness-governor-scoped) and lane-gated to exclude the harness_motor lane (whose cortex_exec_started_step_count is structurally always 0, since that counter only increments for orion-cortex-exec-sourced exec_step_started events) -- previously that always-0 harness_motor-lane reading stomped the real cortex-exec-lane value via mode="replace" on the shared node key. cortex-exec-only proxy for how much active execution work (agent runs, tool calls) is in flight on a node.
How loaded a node's CPU currently is.
How full a node's monitored filesystems are (percent used, max across configured mounts). Distinct from disk_pressure, which measures I/O throughput, not capacity.
Node disk I/O pressure.
1 - confidence that an execution's output actually reached its destination.
How much resistance (retries/backoff) execution is encountering on a node.
Capability-level execution-load pressure.
Signals a node is expected to be offline, so its absence shouldn't be read as a failure.
Recent execution failure rate/severity on a node.
Node BMC fan speed (percent of max, max across fans). A response to thermal load, not an independent hazard on its own -- 0.0 on a node without iLO/BMC credentials configured.
Per-node incoherence score -- fires when two reducers that should agree about a node's state disagree.
How loaded a node's GPU currently is.

FCC-motor-only step-load proxy for one unified Hub turn, split out of cortex_exec_step_load (renamed from execution_load 2026-07-24; blended cortex-exec + harness-governor step counts and hard-capped at 8 before the 2026-07-23 fix) -- a compute/thermal/power cost proxy for how much processing one turn actually cost on the expensive GPU node running the motor.

Share of the calls the LLM gateway sent to this node's model backends that came back without an answer (timeout, refused connection, HTTP error), over the node's last 10 minutes of gateway windows: failures / max(calls, 10), counted only once 2+ failures are in that span (the RPC delivery bridge's rule), and the worse of the whole node and its worst single worker lane (2026-09-29; before that it was one 60 s window with no floor, so one timeout on a quiet minute read 1.0). Reported by the gateway itself; absent when the node got no calls in the span.
Node RAM pressure.
Fraction of live bus-synaptic edges currently anomalous (|z| >= 3.0) -- mesh-wide transport health, not a single-organ fault signal.
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.rest: about 0.01-0.03: a few edges are always over |z| 3. 0.0 means no edge anomalous OR no live edges at all (an empty mesh reads calm).
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.absent_means: carried forward in node_vectors (prediction_error is not a decayed or expiring channel, services/orion-field-digester/app/digestion/decay.py); the self-model drops the domain after 1800 s without a fresh observed_at (orion/substrate/prediction_error_freshness.py:26).

metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.meaning: Node power-draw pressure. Real chassis-wide wattage (iLO/BMC RedFish) when that node has BMC credentials configured; falls back to a GPU-power-only estimate otherwise. 0.0 on a node with neither.
How much a recent prediction (from the prediction/surprise subsystem) missed reality.

Overall load/pressure for a given capability (llm_inference, orchestration, storage, graph, memory, transport, vision). Where an edge feeds it: absent (key and provenance dropped) on a tick when no edge source measured it, never written as a calm 0.0.

How much active LLM-reasoning work a node is doing. Real magnitude since 2026-07-24: cortex-exec-sourced runs use reasoning_char_count (chars); harness-motor-sourced runs use reasoning_output_tokens (real provider-computed tokens from the FCC CLI's own result-event usage object, confirmed live). Falls back to a 0.35/0.05 presence-only flag only when neither magnitude is set.
Capability-level reasoning-load pressure.

Capability-level pressure representing risk to reliability (from execution friction, failures, RPC timeouts, storage write failures, inference failures, vision processing failures). Max over the sources that measured it this tick; where an edge feeds it, absent when none did (e.g. every input expired), never a calm 0.0. capability:transport has one source since 2026-10-07 (RPC timeouts; the bus observer's own failure channel was retired), so it is absent whenever the RPC delivery bridge stops reporting. Capabilities with no reliability edge (graph, memory) still carry reconcile's seeded 0.0, which is not a measurement.
How much conversational "repair" (corrections, re-explaining) is happening in chat.

Caller-side 'asked and got no answer in time' on node:substrate.rpc_delivery: the worst bus request channel's share of rpc_request() calls that hit the caller's own deadline over the last 10 minutes, timeouts / max(calls, 10), counted only once a channel has 2+ timeouts in the window, summed across every service's rpc-health snapshots. A deadline fires on a lost message and on a slow callee alike; on live data it is mostly slow LLM or cortex work. 0.0 means every counted call was answered in time; dropped (unmeasured) when no reading has arrived for 120 s.

How STEADY a node's recent overall strain has been (low volatility/spike-rate), not how loaded it is right now. Opposite polarity from every other physical_substrate channel above -- higher = calmer. See orion.field.pressure.HIGHER_IS_BETTER_CHANNELS.
Whether a node's most recent biometrics sample is too old to trust.

DERIVED (not a raw pre-merge channel): this IS the PRESSURE_DIMENSIONS 'deviation_pressure' value itself, not a channel that feeds it. This tick's admitted field-deviation tension, in [0, 1]. 0.0 is the expected reading once the producer has been running a while ('nothing admitted' is a real, common state) -- but a row from before the producer existed also reads 0.0 (schema default), indistinguishable in storage. Read verdicts from a window entirely after deploy.
Node thermal/temperature pressure.
Is the FCC motor stuck repeating the same tool failure (e.g. a denied permission) instead of adapting, for one turn.

Did Hub fail to get a usable result back from the harness-governor RPC for this turn at all -- the one unified-turn failure mode where no governor-side grammar event exists. A distinct, worse severity than compliance_deficit's worst rank.

Can Orion see at all, on node:substrate.vision_organ: staleness of the freshest camera stream the vision frame router reports (0.0 while any camera's newest frame is under 15 s old, ramping to 1.0 at 60 s). A configured camera that has sent nothing since the router started is aged from that start, never read as calm. 1.0 when no camera delivers or the router stops reporting for 180 s (written on a clock). Per-camera status lives on the vision organ projection. Dropped (unmeasured) when no reading has arrived for 300 s.
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.rest: 0.0 = at least one camera delivered a frame in the last 15 s.
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.absent_means: dropped (unmeasured) after 300 s without a reading; 1.0 (not absent) when the router itself is silent for 180 s.

metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.meaning: Share of the frames the vision frame router handed to the vision host over the last 10 minutes that came back without a usable answer (timeout, invalid reply, ok=false), failures / max(attempts, 10), counted once 2+ failures are in the span; the worse of the pooled share and the worst single camera's. Absent when nothing was dispatched; dropped (unmeasured) when no reading has arrived for 300 s.
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.rest: 0.0 = every frame dispatched in the last 10 minutes came back usable, or fewer than 2 failed.
metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.absent_means: absent when nothing was dispatched; dropped (unmeasured) after 300 s without a reading.

metric://field_channel/orion-field-diges.meaning: Storage writes that did not land, on node:substrate.storage_write: orion-sql-writer's own count of incoming writes that did not reach their Postgres table (schema/validation reject, constraint violation, serialization error, database unavailable or timed out, grammar queue shed), as the worst table family's failed / max(attempted, 10) over the last 10 minutes of writer windows, counted only once a family has 2+ failures. Idempotent duplicates are not failures; unrouted kinds are not counted. 0.0 means every counted write in the span landed; dropped (unmeasured) when no writer window has been reduced for 180 s.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: How much the machines' pressure readings moved since the last sample: mean absolute change across pressure hints, 0.30 of change = 1.0 (a fixed scale, not versus its own history).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: about 0.02-0.03 (sensor jitter); 0.0 = nothing moved at all.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: carried forward in node_vectors between biometrics samples; dropped from the self-model after 1800 s.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: TRIGGER: cabinet is warming unexpectedly -- fires only while the cabinet thermal state is 'elevated' (never while 'hot') and the temperature rose at least 0.5 C in the last 15 minutes; value is rise/1.0 C, so 0.5-1.0 when it fires. FalkorDB node only; not in FieldStateV1 node_vectors.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = not elevated, or elevated but not rising >= 0.5 C in 15 min. Mostly zero by design (97% live).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: when the thermal reading is 'unknown' (older than the 300 s grace) the tick writes nothing and the node keeps its last value (worker.py:1434).

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: How much more the chat's load and repair pressure moved on the turns touched this batch than they usually move: clipped z-score versus its own running average, 3 sigma = 1.0.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = at or below the usual turn-to-turn movement, or no baseline yet. Mostly zero by design (69% live).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: only written when chat turns were touched; carried forward in node_vectors between turns, dropped from the self-model after 1800 s.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: How unusual the latest codebase change event (git, PR, graph) was versus each source's own history: mean clipped z-score across the sub-domains, 3 sigma = 1.0.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = no sub-domain above its usual. Mostly zero by design (91% live).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: only written on a codebase delta event; carried forward in node_vectors between events.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: How much more execution pressure changed this batch than it usually does: z-score of the mean change in 4 execution pressure hints versus its own running average, negatives clipped, 3 sigma = 1.0.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = change at or below its usual (negative z clipped), or no baseline yet. Mostly zero by design (72% live).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: only written when a batch carried execution events; between batches the last value is carried forward in node_vectors, and the self-model drops the domain after 1800 s.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: PLACEHOLDER: a fixed 0.65 written each time a harness turn closes with its surprise unresolved -- a yes/no shown as a size, until HarnessPostTurnClosureV1 carries surprise_level_at_draft. FalkorDB node only; not in FieldStateV1 node_vectors.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: none designed: the node holds 0.65 after the first unresolved closure and nothing writes it lower. 0.65 is not a measured surprise level.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: the node keeps its last 0.65; endogenous curiosity decays its use linearly to 0 over 1800 s of age (orion/substrate/endogenous_curiosity.py:129).

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: How surprising the camera scene is versus that stream's own recent normal: embedding distance from its running average, z-scored against its own history, negatives clipped, 3 sigma = 1.0.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = at or below this stream's usual surprise. Also 0.0 while the baseline is still warming (fewer than 2 surprise samples) and when the frame is stale -- so 0 here does NOT prove the camera is working; node:substrate.vision_organ's vision_frame_staleness carries that.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: written as 0.0 every tick rather than dropped; nothing written until 15 s after process start before the first embedding arrives.

metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.meaning: COUNT: how many of the 4 routing decisions (lane, lane reason, output mode, mind requested) changed versus the previous decided run, as a share (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1); averaged when a batch holds several runs.
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.rest: 0.0 = routing made the same decision as last time (or no decided run this batch). Mostly zero by design (87% live).
metric://field_channel/orion-substrate-r.absent_means: only written when routing runs were touched; carried forward in node_vectors, dropped from the self-model after 1800 s.

metric://inner_state/orion-cortex-exec/a.rest: none: this is a RANK among the loops scored together, not a magnitude. Steps of 1/(2(n-1)); every loop tied -> 0.5. Calm and crisis can read the same.
metric://inner_state/orion-cortex-exec/a.absent_means: no row when no loop was scored (one row per scored loop).

metric://inner_state/orion-dream/drive_r.rest: 0.0 = nothing new since the last sleep began; reached live at the first check after every sleep (2026-10-10 01:32 UTC). Rises in steps of one new thing's replay weight; due at >= threshold (3.0).
metric://inner_state/orion-dream/drive_r.absent_means: Redis key expired (TTL 1800 s) or state no_reading: UNKNOWN, and every reader behaves as before the drive existed. Never read as rested or tired.

metric://inner_state/orion-equilibrium-s.rest: 0.0 = every tracked service heartbeating within grace. Mean partial downtime across services, so one dead service among N reads 1/N (live median 0.025, 2026-10-07).
metric://inner_state/orion-equilibrium-s.absent_means: a service silent past state_retention_sec is purged and stops counting -- a long outage can read calmer.

metric://inner_state/orion-field-digeste.rest: 0.0 = every queue at or below its recent normal depth and nothing waited past its expected wait. Scale is 0-10, not 0-1; below 0.5 it is never shown.
metric://inner_state/orion-field-digeste.absent_means: schema default 0.0 -- a row from before the producer ran reads the same as calm.
declared_consumers: orion.hub.turn_orchestrator:_maybe_splice_role_teach_disclosure (hire role-teach queue contention disclosure; Task 8 wires FieldState score into curiosity progress_lines)

metric://inner_state/orion-field-digeste.rest: 0.0 = no (channel, node) is loaded AND steady this window; otherwise the highest such level, continuous in (0, 1] -- not two-valued.
metric://inner_state/orion-field-digeste.absent_means: carried forward unchanged between 30 s recomputes and on a failed window read (no decay).

metric://inner_state/orion-hub/repair_pr.rest: 0.65 at rest on the text-fallback path (a constant, not a measured confidence); min of the active kinds' confidences once any kind fires.
metric://inner_state/orion-hub/repair_pr.absent_means: no row on a turn the appraisal did not run.

metric://inner_state/orion-hub/repair_pr.rest: 0.087 = the classifier's confident all-NO floor (every repair kind answered NO); never exactly 0 on the classifier path. 0.45 is the contract's mid.
metric://inner_state/orion-hub/repair_pr.absent_means: no row on a turn the appraisal did not run.

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: 0.3 = no settled coalition (flickering). 0.6 = transitioning, 0.9 = held > 3 ticks. Three tiers, not a measured stability; the schema default 1.0 is never produced.
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: dwell history is in-process, so it resets to 0.3 on a substrate-runtime restart.

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: 0.3 = no settled coalition. In practice a 3-tier dwell bucket (0.9/0.6/0.3) named 'confidence'; continuous only on the rare field-salience-only branch.
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: schema allows None; never None in 5,933 live rows (3 days to 2026-10-10).

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: about 2-3 (far end of the heartbeat profile twice the near end); 'smeared' at >= 0.5. Bounded at SMEAR_DEAD_RATIO=10 since PR #2571 (orion-heartbeat proprioception.py:46,123): healthy readings sit at 0.94-5.5, so a value near 10 is the edge of 'alive'.
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: None when the near end is dead: below the 1e-6 floor or far/near > 10 (near end carries < 1/10 of the far end's entanglement). Before #2571 this read 1e4-1.5e6.

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: about 0.97-0.99: near-ceiling because most domain prediction errors rest at or near 0. 1 - mean error, so only a broad surprise moves it.
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: None when no active domain has a fresh reading (each drops after 1800 s, orion/substrate/prediction_error_freshness.py:26).

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: 0.0 = no goal or no open loops, so attention ran bottom-up. When top-down fires it almost always spends the full budget (1.0).
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: None when the broadcast lane is stale.

metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.rest: none: a candidate exists only above its source's floor (prediction_error >= 0.55, repair_pressure >= 0.6, open loop >= 0.5). Meaning differs by source: a decayed node prediction error, a repair appraisal level, loop novelty, or a fixed 0.65/0.45 coverage-gap bucket.
metric://inner_state/orion-substrate-run.absent_means: no candidate (not a 0.0) when nothing clears its floor.
